document_title: National Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Policy (NREEEP)
summary: Sets targets and frameworks for renewable energy adoption and efficiency measures.
Long-term roadmap for scaling renewable energy contributions to national mix.
Promotes domestic gas utilization for power and industry; pricing frameworks.
Obligates gas suppliers to allocate a portion to the domestic market.
Framework for 0-1 MW mini-grids (registration/permit), interconnection, tariffs.
Allows large customers to purchase power directly from generators.
